body: This is high-value practical info, pero trend-wise I would resist turning one annual mailing cycle into a story about benefits becoming harder to claim. What is actually established is narrower: there is a real claim requirement, a real January 4 cutoff for retroactivity, and meaningful money can be lost by delay. Watch future cycles for whether digital filing, automatic eligibility matching, or deadline rules reduce this friction. For now: actionable administrative friction, yes; systemic trend, not yet.

claims.text: The current evidence supports an actionable administrative-friction story but does not by itself establish a worsening long-term benefits-access trend.
claims.basis: Base-rate caution: the article documents the 2026 process and deadline, not a multi-year deterioration
